create_ObjectRef_from_blender_object: create an ObjectRef from a Blender object or bone using the new_object or new_bone class methods
get_local_transform_of_object: get the local affine transform including position and rotation quaternion for a Blender object or bone
get_rotation_dofs_for_bone: get the rotation degrees of freedom with IK limits for a bone in an armature
map_blender_scene_tree: map a callback over all scene objects and bones in breadth-first order using map_blender_tree
validate_material_mesh_pair: validate whether a mesh-material pair contains any geometry using is_material_mesh_pair_valid
